第21章 一句话将薰儿哄成胎盘（第1页）
一句话，将薰儿哄成胎盘！（一句话，将薰儿哄成胎盘！（第22页）她什么也没做错，只是，萧炎和薰儿身上的光芒太过耀眼，让他们只能看得到彼此，却看不到身边那被掩盖了光芒的孤星。“好啦，没什么事情，就跟我走吧，我有东西要送给你。”萧炎笑着说道。“是什么？”薰儿闻言顿时眼前一亮，一双眼睛笑得弯成了月牙，看得萧炎的心情都变得晴朗许多。“这里人多眼杂，我们找个安静一些的地方再说。”虽然薰儿是信得过的，但若是在这里掏出聚气散，估计会直接让整个萧家都为之动荡。“好哦！”薰儿乖巧地点点头，旋即伸手抱住萧炎的胳膊，小脑袋凑到了萧炎肩头，笑盈盈地说道。萧炎见状也回以笑容，旋即拿着手中的斗技卷轴，在斗技堂管理员处登记了一下，便是在一众少年艳羡的目光下，带着薰儿离开了斗技堂。萧媚也没了待下去的心情，礼貌性的跟表哥萧宁打了一个招呼，便独自离去了。至于萧宁……他对薰儿自然也有几分好感，但是萧炎的光芒实在是太过璀璨，让他有些自惭形秽，看着萧炎和薰儿那俊男靓女的组合，他也只能叹息一声，寻了一卷斗技，闷头学习起来。薰儿屋内。放眼整个萧家，也只有萧炎能进入这里。除此之外，就是凌影，如果没有薰儿的许可，来汇报消息也得跪在外面。“萧炎哥哥？”虽然屋内有桌椅，但薰儿还是直接拉着萧炎坐在了床边，好奇的目光，看向萧炎。“我就不卖关子了，呐！”萧炎说着，从纳戒里取出了那特地买来的品质极好的玉盒，递给了薰儿。“这是…聚气散？”薰儿打开玉盒，稍加端详，便是看出了丹药的品类。“嗯。”萧炎点点头。“萧炎哥哥怎么会有这个？”薰儿眼帘微垂，眼中闪过一丝深意，旋即抬起头，面带惊喜之色，好奇地问道。“是这样的，我又拜了一位老师，是一名炼药宗师，你不是九段斗之气了吗？我想着，正好请老师炼制了一枚聚气散，虽然我知道，即便是没有这东西，你也能成功晋级斗者，但如果有的话，自然是更好的。”萧炎笑着说道。“炼药宗师？”薰儿闻言有些狐疑地望着萧炎。以她的眼力，不难看出，这枚聚气散的品质，比起族内送来的聚气散，还要高一些。但炼药宗师是怎么让萧炎哥哥碰上的？还拜师……嗯？薰儿反应了过来，有些欣喜：“这么说，萧炎哥哥能够成为炼药师了？”“对，是这样的。”萧炎颔首。“那薰儿要恭喜萧炎哥哥了，炼药师可是大陆上最受人尊敬的职业，再配合萧炎哥哥的修炼天赋，日后定然是名震大陆的超级强者了！”薰儿笑盈盈地将丹药收好，认真说道。“嗯，我会努力达到那一步的，所以薰儿你也要加油，若是站在绝巅上，身边却无人相伴，那我会很孤独的。”萧炎笑着说道。闻言，薰儿瞪大了眼睛，小脸突然泛起红晕，整个人都懵了。“好啦，你收好丹药，好生修炼，我得去研究斗技了。”说罢，萧炎便是起身离去，而薰儿则是有些傻乎乎的点点头，目送萧炎离去。满脑子就只剩下一句话在回荡：萧炎哥哥说，希望未来他的身边，能有自己相伴呢！

Chapter 21 One word coaxes Xun'er into a placenta (page 1)
In one sentence, Xun'er can be coaxed into a placenta! (In one sentence, she coaxed Xun'er into a placenta! (Page 22) She did nothing wrong, but the light on Xiao Yan and Xun'er was too dazzling, so that they could only see each other, but not the lone star beside them that was covered by the light. "Okay, if you have nothing to do, just come with me, I have something to give you." Xiao Yan said with a smile. "What is it?" Xun'er's eyes suddenly lit up after hearing this, and her eyes turned into crescents with laughter. Seeing that Xiao Yan's mood became much brighter. "There are many people here, let's find a quieter place." Although Xun'er was trustworthy, if he took out the Qi Gathering Powder here, it would probably make the entire Xiao family tremble. "Okay!" The fighting skills scroll was registered with the administrator of the fighting skills hall, and under the envious eyes of all the teenagers, Xiao Mei left the fighting skills hall with Xun'er. Xiao Mei was no longer in the mood to stay, and politely fought with her cousin Xiao Ning. After saying hello, he left alone. As for Xiao Ning...he naturally had a good impression of Xun'er, but Xiao Yan's light was too bright, which made him feel a little ashamed. Looking at Xiao Yan and Xun'er's handsome man and woman, He could only sigh, search for a volume of fighting skills, and start studying. Looking at the entire Xiao family, only Xiao Yan could enter here. Besides, even Ling Ying had to kneel outside to report the news without Xun'er's permission. "Brother Xiao Yan?" Although there were tables and chairs in the room, Xun'er still pulled Xiao Yan to sit by the bed and looked at Xiao Yan curiously. "Xun'er said, taking out the jade box of excellent quality that he bought specially from the ring, and handed it to Xun'er. "Is this... Qi Gathering Powder?" Xun'er opened the jade box and looked at it for a moment, and saw the type of elixir. "Yeah." Xiao Yan nodded. "Why does brother Xiao Yan have this?" "Teacher, you are a master of alchemy. Aren't you a nine-level fighting spirit?" I thought, and asked the teacher to refine a Qi Gathering Powder. Although I know that you can successfully advance to the Doujie level without this thing, but it would be better if you did. Qi dispersion is even higher. But how did Brother Xiao Yan meet the master of alchemy? Huh? Xun'er reacted and was a little happy: "So, brother Xiao Yan can become an alchemist?" "Yes, that's true." "Yes!" Xun'er put the elixir away with a smile and said seriously. "Well, I will work hard to reach that point, so Xun'er, you have to work hard. If I stand on the top with no one by my side, I will be very lonely. "Xiao Yan said with a smile. Hearing this, Xun'er's eyes widened, her face suddenly turned red, and she was stunned. "Okay, you put the pills away and practice hard. I have to study fighting skills." After that, Xiao Yan said.Xun'er stood up and left, while Xun'er nodded stupidly and watched Xiao Yan leave. There was only one sentence left in his mind: Brother Xiao Yan said that he hoped to have him by his side in the future!
